item.title: Pueblo Mayor Heather Graham delivers State of the City address Tuesday
item.description: Pueblo Mayor Heather Graham delivered her State of the City address Tuesday evening. She thanked the police department, highlighting the homicide rate this past year is the lowest since 2019.

item.title: Kamrin Lane leads Falcon to 10th straight win with 61-42 victory over TCA
item.description: Falcon has been hot since the start of the new year, running off ten straight wins and improving to 7-0 in league play. They defeated The Classical Academy 61-52 for their tenth straight win.

item.title: Colorado Springs considers zoning changes to expand access to childcare
item.description: Long waitlists and high prices make childcare hard to find in Colorado Springs. City leaders say zoning changes could allow more daycares in residential neighborhoods, here’s what’s being proposed.
